latest.title: "Which Agent Is Costing Me the Most?" — Per-Agent Cost Attribution for Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
latest.description: Calculate per-agent cost on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore by correlating each runtime's IAM role with Bedrock model invocation logs — no code changes or Application Inference Profiles needed. Walks through the three-step logic (list runtimes, query logs by role, pull CloudWatch metrics), the gotchas, and how to turn it into a live CloudWatch dashboard with hourly custom metrics, alarms, and anomaly detection.

latest.title: 🚀 Bridge to the Cloud: A Tactical Guide to Hybrid Resilience with Nutanix NC2 on AWS
latest.description:
The Challenge: Beyond the "Lift and Shift" Fatigue
In Latin America, organizations face a "hybrid paradox": craving AWS elasticity while tethered to on-premises legacy workloads on vCenter or Hyper-V. The true fear isn’t migration, but operational fragmentation—disparate tools and failure modes. Success requires moving beyond just migrating VMs toward achieving operational symmetry. This is where Nutanix NC2 on AWS becomes a game-changer.

latest.title: Soft skills e hard skills: o que são, por que importam e como equilibrar na prática
latest.description: Neste artigo, explico a diferença entre habilidades técnicas e comportamentais usando uma metáfora simples: a construção de uma casa. Mostro por que as hard skills (os tijolos) são essenciais no início da carreira, mas as soft skills (a capacidade de conversar, negociar e ouvir) se tornam cada vez mais decisivas com o tempo. Também compartilho um exercício prático de duas colunas para você identificar o que precisa estudar e o que precisa praticar no dia a dia.

trending.description: ASET (Academic Safety and Evidencing Truth) is an AI-powered claim verification platform built on AWS that verifies scientific claims against 1.2M+ peer-reviewed papers across 8 domains — and automatically fetches and permanently stores new papers from arXiv, PubMed, etc. when gaps are found, making the knowledge base self-growing with every query.
